question: Can a shelf-crop closed-set classifier recover the no-reference, sentinel, and shelf-domain cases that retrieval cannot solve well?
success_gate: Improves full-slice and hard-bucket recognition, especially missing-reference, unknown_sentinel, and low-view regimes, without collapsing strong reference-safe classes.
notes: Use the classifier manifests under data/2026-03-19/derived/crop-classifier and the frozen recipe in docs/norgesgruppen-data/plans/PLAN-0005-exp-0013a-first-classifier-recipe.md. Run tiny-overfit and shuffled-label controls before trusting any real classifier result. Primary goal is not to beat retrieval everywhere; it is to recover missing-reference, unknown, and shelf-domain cases retrieval cannot solve well.
